receipts.detail: a snapshot lane still in flight at the deadline is classified blind and carries its typed lane reason, instead of being read as a sighted oracle reporting an inactive cluster
an empty probe-witness list that carries no deadline-bounded lane marker keeps its prior not-blind meaning, and a completed lane with a sighted witness stays sighted
the tracker, the failure message, the diagnostics stamp and the node-level inactivity precedence rule are unchanged
the deadline-bounded record its producer emits, the re-sample admission and the progress classification are unchanged
both witness files re-run together with the identical outcome
